name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a decade in the Croatian military police, specializing in threat assessment and risk mitigation, he sought a new challenge. A chance encounter with a former racing engineer led him to explore the high-stakes world of motorsport security. He quickly adapted his skills, recognizing the unique challenges of protecting teams, drivers, and assets in a fast-paced, international environment.

Marko's pragmatic approach is his defining characteristic. He believes in thorough planning, meticulous execution, and constant vigilance. He's not one for grand pronouncements or flashy displays; his focus is on identifying vulnerabilities and implementing robust countermeasures. Marko is known for his ability to remain calm under pressure and make decisive decisions in critical situations. He brings a level of discipline and rigor to Stewart-Haas Racing, ensuring the team's safety and security are never compromised.

What sets Marko apart is his understanding of human behavior. He's a keen observer, able to read people and anticipate potential problems before they escalate. This intuition, combined with his military training, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.
